title: IndianPlantRecord
description: Botanical record schema for Indian Plant Species Identification and Health Analysis System

id.description: Unique stable identifier (slug format, e.g. 'oryza-sativa' or 'mangifera-indica')

scientific_name.description: Accepted botanical scientific binomial or trinomial name

hindi_name.description: Hindi vernacular name in Devanagari script and transliteration

telugu_name.description: Telugu vernacular name in Telugu script and transliteration

tamil_name.description: Tamil vernacular name in Tamil script and transliteration

other_regional_names.description: Vernacular names in other Indian languages (Kannada, Malayalam, Bengali, Marathi, Gujarati, Punjabi, Odia, Assamese)

synonyms.description: Botanical synonyms and alternative orthographic spellings

category.description: Primary agricultural, horticultural, or ecological category

status_in_india.description: Status of the species in India

indian_states.description: Indian states or biogeographical regions where presence is documented

stem_characteristics.description: Stem growth form, bark, thorns, texture

flower_characteristics.description: Inflorescence type, petal color, symmetry, flowering season

fruit_characteristics.description: Fruit type, seed morphology, color, maturation period

growth_habit.description: Growth habit and typical dimensions (height, canopy spread)

habitat_and_climate.description: Ecological niche, climate zones, elevation tolerance

sunlight_requirements.description: Full sun, partial shade, shade tolerance

soil_preferences.description: Soil texture, drainage, optimal pH range

growing_season.description: Kharif, Rabi, Zaid, perennial, or flowering months

propagation_methods.description: Documented propagation techniques (seeds, cuttings, grafting, etc.)

uses.description: Documented food, medicinal, timber, industrial, or cultural uses

safety_notes.description: Toxicity warnings, allergen advisories, or handling precautions

is_toxic.description: Whether any plant part is toxic to humans or livestock

prevention_guidance.description: General preventive agronomic or horticultural care guidelines
